label: NewBarkTown_Lab_Text_ElmIntro
source:
ELM: {PLAYER}! There you are!\pI needed to ask you a favor.\pI'm conducting new POKéMON
research right now. I was\lwondering if you could help\lme with it, {PLAYER}.\pYou see…\pI'm writing a paper that I
want to present at a conference.\pBut there are some things I
don't quite understand yet.\pSo!\pI'd like you to raise a
POKéMON that I recently caught.$
translation:
空木：{PLAYER}！你来啦！\p我有件事想拜托你。\p我正在做新的宝可梦
研究，\l想请你帮帮忙，\l{PLAYER}。\p你看……\p我正在写一篇论文，
想在学会上发表。\p但还有些地方
我怎么也想不明白。\p所以！\p我想请你培育一只
我最近刚捉到的宝可梦。$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon
source:
OAK: It's unsafe!
Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!\pYou need your own POKéMON for
your protection.\pI know!
Here, come with me!$
translation:
大木：外面很危险！
草丛里住着野生宝可梦！\p你需要有自己的宝可梦
来保护自己。\p我知道了！
跟我来吧！$

label: PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex
source: OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}!\nYou're back, are you?\pHow much have you filled in your\nPOKéDEX?\pMay I see it?\pLet's see…$
translation: 大木：啊，{PLAYER}！\n你回来啦？\p你的宝可梦图鉴\n填了多少了？\p能让我看看吗？\p我看看……$

label: PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThreeMonsChooseOne
source:
OAK: {RIVAL}?
Let me think…\pOh, that's right, I told you to
come! Just wait!\pHere, {PLAYER}.\pThere are three POKéMON here.\pHaha!\pThe POKéMON are held inside
these POKé BALLS.\pWhen I was young, I was a serious
POKéMON TRAINER.\pBut now, in my old age, I have
only these three left.\pYou can have one.
Go on, choose!$
translation:
大木：{RIVAL}？
让我想想……\p哦，对了，是我让你
来的！稍等一下！\p给你，{PLAYER}。\p这里有三只宝可梦。\p哈哈！\p宝可梦都装在
这些精灵球里。\p我年轻的时候也是个
很厉害的训练家。\p但现在年纪大了，
身边只剩下这三只。\p你可以选一只。
来吧，挑一只吧！$
